mapper.select: /* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.indivStdList 설 명 : 개별 수강생 목록 */ SELECT USR.USER_ID , USR.USERNM , USR.STDNT_NO , DEPT.DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = ATNDLC.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID WHERE ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND USR.USER_STSCD = 'ACTV' ORDER BY USR.USERNM

/* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.indivSbmsnTrgtList 설 명 : 개별 과제 제출 대상 목록 */ SELECT TRGT.ASMT_ID , TRGT.USER_ID , USR.USERNM , USR.STDNT_NO , DEPT.DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND USR.USER_STSCD = 'ACTV' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID WHERE TRGT.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND TRGT.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRGT.TEAM_ID IS NULL ORDER BY USR.USERNM
mapper.sql: WITH LAST_SBMSN AS ( SELECT SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY SBMSN.ASMT_ID, SBMSN.USER_ID ORDER BY SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.REG_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN WHERE SBMSN.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND SBMSN.DELYN = 'N' ) SELECT TRGT.ASMT_ID , TRGT.USER_ID , USR.USERNM , USR.STDNT_NO , DEPT.DEPTNM , NVL(TRGT.RESBMSN_PRMYN, 'N') AS RESBMSN_PRMYN , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , NVL(SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD, 'NON_SBMSN') AS SBMSN_STSCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND USR.USER_STSCD = 'ACTV' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN LAST_SBMSN SBMSN ON SBMSN.ASMT_ID = TRGT.ASMT_ID AND SBMSN.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND SBMSN.RN = 1 WHERE TRGT.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND TRGT.USER_ID IS NOT NULL

/* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.resbmsnCandidateList 설 명 : 재제출 후보자 목록 */ SELECT BASE.ASMT_ID , BASE.USER_ID , BASE.USERNM , BASE.STDNT_NO , BASE.DEPTNM , BASE.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , BASE.SBMSN_STSCD , BASE.RESBMSN_PRMYN , BASE.SBMSN_DTTM FROM (
) BASE WHERE BASE.RESBMSN_PRMYN = 'N' AND BASE.SBMSN_STSCD IN ('NON_SBMSN') ORDER BY BASE.USERNM

/* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.resbmsnTrgtList 설 명 : 재제출 대상자 목록 */ SELECT BASE.ASMT_ID , BASE.USER_ID , BASE.USERNM , BASE.STDNT_NO , BASE.DEPTNM , BASE.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , BASE.SBMSN_STSCD , BASE.RESBMSN_PRMYN , BASE.SBMSN_DTTM FROM (
) BASE WHERE BASE.RESBMSN_PRMYN = 'Y' AND BASE.SBMSN_STSCD IN ('NON_SBMSN') ORDER BY BASE.USERNM
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.asmtMemoModify 설 명 : 과제 메모 수정 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL ASMT_EVL USING ( SELECT #{asmtEvlId} AS ASMT_EVL_ID , #{asmtId} AS ASMT_ID , #{userId} AS USER_ID , #{teamId} AS TEAM_ID , #{evlMemo} AS EVL_MEMO , #{rgtrId} AS RGTR_ID , #{mdfrId} AS MDFR_ID FROM DUAL ) USR ON ( ASMT_EVL.ASMT_ID = USR.ASMT_ID AND ASMT_EVL.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ASMT_EVL.EVL_MEMO = SUBSTR(USR.EVL_MEMO, 1, 4000) , ASMT_EVL.MDFR_ID = USR.MDFR_ID , ASMT_EVL.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ASMT_EVL_ID , EVL_MEMO , EVLYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , ASMT_ID , USER_ID , TEAM_ID ) VALUES ( USR.ASMT_EVL_ID , SUBSTR(USR.EVL_MEMO, 1, 4000) , 'N' , USR.RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() , USR.ASMT_ID , USR.USER_ID , USR.TEAM_ID )

/* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.asmtMemoAppendModify 설 명 : 과제 메모 덧붙이기 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL ASMT_EVL USING ( SELECT #{asmtEvlId} AS ASMT_EVL_ID , #{asmtId} AS ASMT_ID , #{userId} AS USER_ID , #{teamId} AS TEAM_ID , #{evlMemo} AS EVL_MEMO , #{rgtrId} AS RGTR_ID , #{mdfrId} AS MDFR_ID FROM DUAL ) USR ON ( ASMT_EVL.ASMT_ID = USR.ASMT_ID AND ASMT_EVL.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ASMT_EVL.EVL_MEMO = SUBSTR( CASE WHEN ASMT_EVL.EVL_MEMO IS NULL OR ASMT_EVL.EVL_MEMO = '' THEN USR.EVL_MEMO ELSE ASMT_EVL.EVL_MEMO || CHR(10) || USR.EVL_MEMO END , 1 , 4000 ) , ASMT_EVL.MDFR_ID = USR.MDFR_ID , ASMT_EVL.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ASMT_EVL_ID , EVL_MEMO , EVLYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , ASMT_ID , USER_ID , TEAM_ID ) VALUES ( USR.ASMT_EVL_ID , SUBSTR(USR.EVL_MEMO, 1, 4000) , 'N' , USR.RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() , USR.ASMT_ID , USR.USER_ID , USR.TEAM_ID )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.prevAsmtSbmsnList 설 명 : 이전과제제출목록 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY USER_SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , ASMT.ASMT_ID DESC ) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(1) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT , ASMT.ASMT_ID , ASMT.SBJCT_ID , ASMT.ASMT_GBNCD , GBNCD.CDNM AS ASMT_GBNNM , ASMT.ASMT_TTL /* 제출 */ , USER_SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , USER_SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , USER_SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD , USER_SBMSN.SBMSN_CTS , USER_SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT , USER_SBMSN.SBMSN_TYCD , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(USER_SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID) AS FILE_CNT , TRGT.USER_ID , EVL.ASMT_EVL_ID , EVL.SCR FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT ON TRGT.ASMT_ID = ASMT.ASMT_ID AND TRGT.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_CTS , SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT , SBMSN.SBMSN_TYCD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID ORDER BY SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.REG_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID DESC ) RN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN WHERE SBMSN.DELYN = 'N' AND SBMSN.USER_ID = #{userId} ) USER_SBMSN ON USER_SBMSN.ASMT_ID = ASMT.ASMT_ID AND USER_SBMSN.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND USER_SBMSN.RN = 1 /* 평가 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON EVL.ASMT_ID = ASMT.ASMT_ID AND EVL.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD GBNCD ON GBNCD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND GBNCD.UP_CD = 'ASMT_GBNCD' AND GBNCD.CD = ASMT.ASMT_GBNCD WHERE ASMT.DELYN = 'N' AND ASMT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} /* 현재 일반과제 → 해당 과제만 제외 현재 부과제 → 같은 상위과제의 모든 부과제 제외 현재 상위과제 → 상위과제 + 그 부과제들 제외 */ AND NVL(ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID, ASMT.ASMT_ID) != ( SELECT NVL(CURR_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID, CURR_ASMT.ASMT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_ASMT CURR_ASMT WHERE CURR_ASMT.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} ) ORDER BY USER_SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , ASMT.ASMT_ID DESC

/* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.asmtSbmsnHistList 설 명 : 과제 제출 이력 조회 */ SELECT SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID , SBMSN.TEAM_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_TYCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , SBMSN.SBMSN_CTS , SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN WHERE SBMSN.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND SBMSN.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SBMSN.DELYN = 'N' ORDER BY SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.REG_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID DESC

/* SQL ID : AsmtProfIndivDAO.lastAsmtSbmsnSelect 설 명 : 마지막 과제 제출 조회 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.TEAM_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , SBMSN.SBMSN_TYCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_CTS , SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT , SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_CNT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID ORDER BY SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.REG_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID DESC ) RN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN WHERE SBMSN.DELYN = 'N' AND SBMSN.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND SBMSN.USER_ID = #{userId} ) MAIN WHERE MAIN.RN = 1
